Package model.order

Class Order

java.lang.Object
model.order.Order
public class Order extends Object
/src/model/order/Order.java
Author:
Uriel Neves Silva (https://gitlab.com/a253119un), Carles Conesa Mañosa (https://gitlab.com/carlesconesa34) Represents a live table order from the moment it is opened until it is paid. Holds a list of OrderItems and tracks its own status to prevent illegal modifications. The Waiter creates it, the customer's allergens shape its contents, and markPaid() locks it permanently. uses → OrderStatus: Tracks the order's lifecycle. composition → OrderItem: An order cannot exist without its items. association → Table: Each order is linked to a specific table.
